messages:
ash: hey team, day 1 here — trying to build a tiny 'who-does-what' map for quick reference. who do I ping for: runtime/model serving bugs, infra/VPC & access, embedding/index infra, and who to page for P0s?

sam: welcome ash! runtime & model serving = eng-runtime (me). for regressions include: repro steps, trace ids, and sample prompt. post in #eng-runtime, and tag @eng-sre if latency is >SLO.

mina: infra/VPC/access = infra team. open an infra ticket with network diagram + reason. for onboarding we have an "expedite" tag, DM me the ticket if you need it faster.

tara: embedding/index infra = eng-ml (ping #eng-ml). for large indexing jobs include data size, expected qps, and desired ANN settings. if you need batch GPU for indexing, mention that in the ticket.

ash: thanks — what's the paging/escalation route for P0s?

eng-sre: PD pages oncall first. escalation: oncall -> oncall-lead -> eng-sre manager. if unresolved after 15m, product manager is pulled in. for security-impacting incidents, page @jordan and add `sensitive=true`. post incident link in #incidents.

jordan: security addendum: anything that touches customer data or keys should be treated as high-sev until triaged. please avoid posting raw customer data in Slack. use the incident form: https://docs.redwood.com/security/incident-form

ash: who signs off model rollouts to prod?

sam: rollout signoff = engineering owner + product + infra ops. if model is tagged sensitive, security signoff required. we do a 24h staging canary and check perf + regression tests. add the rollout checklist to your ticket; here's the quick local command to run pre-rollout tests:
```
./scripts/check_rollout.sh --model <path> --smoke --eval
```
Include eval summary and latency percentiles.

mina: quick note on access: production keys require two approvers (infra + eng owner) and time-limited access by default. use the Access Request template in Confluence.

ops-bot: Action: added ash to `dev-access` and `redwood-oncall` Okta groups.

ash: super helpful, thank you. any Slack channels I should join immediately?

tara: join #eng-runtime, #eng-ml, #infra, #incidents, and #onboarding. also subscribe to the Runbooks page in Confluence.

ash: last one  if I find a stale runbook or missing owner, what's the easiest fix?

sam: create a small PR in the runbooks repo with the update and add `help-wanted` if you're not sure who to tag. runbooks use `pd:policy:<id>` links for pager refs so names stay current.

ash: awesome. i'll open the model onboarding ticket now and tag you folks. thanks for the quick map! :raised_hands:

mina: welcome aboard — ping if you want a walkthrough of the infra ticketing flow later today.

ash: would love that, thanks :smile:
